# GENERATED FILE. DO NOT EDIT.
# Source: tools/auto_upgrade_buildings_1_21_0.json

aub_start_global_loop_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = aub_auto_build_loop_started } }
		set_global_variable = { name = aub_auto_build_loop_started value = 1 }
		trigger_event = { id = auto_build.0005 days = 1 }
	}
}

aub_transfer_auto_build_to_player_heir_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_character_flag = enable_auto_build
			exists = player_heir
		}
		player_heir = {
			# The successor must receive one exact policy, even if that character
			# already carried stale flags from an earlier player-controlled life.
			remove_character_flag = aub_funding_treasury_only
			remove_character_flag = aub_funding_personal_only
			remove_character_flag = aub_pause_when_over_domain_limit
			add_character_flag = enable_auto_build
			if = {
				limit = { root = { has_character_flag = aub_funding_treasury_only } }
				add_character_flag = aub_funding_treasury_only
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { root = { has_character_flag = aub_funding_personal_only } }
				add_character_flag = aub_funding_personal_only
			}
			if = {
				limit = { root = { has_character_flag = aub_pause_when_over_domain_limit } }
				add_character_flag = aub_pause_when_over_domain_limit
			}
			aub_start_global_loop_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:aub_payer = { has_character_flag = aub_funding_treasury_only } }
		scope:aub_payer = { remove_short_term_treasury = $GOLD$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:aub_payer = { has_character_flag = aub_funding_personal_only } }
		scope:aub_payer = { remove_short_term_gold = $GOLD$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			scope:aub_payer = {
				has_treasury = yes
				treasury >= $GOLD$
			}
		}
		scope:aub_payer = { remove_short_term_treasury = $GOLD$ }
	}
	else = {
		scope:aub_payer = { remove_short_term_gold = $GOLD$ }
	}
	# Every payment is reached only after the target building exists.
	# Prestige/piety payments delegate here, so each success counts once.
	scope:aub_payer = { change_variable = { name = aub_upgrades_this_scan add = 1 } }
}

aub_pay_gold_prestige_building_cost_effect = {
	aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = $GOLD$ }
	scope:aub_payer = {
		add_prestige = {
			value = $PRESTIGE$
			multiply = -1
		}
	}
}

aub_pay_gold_piety_building_cost_effect = {
	aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = $GOLD$ }
	scope:aub_payer = {
		add_piety = {
			value = $PIETY$
			multiply = -1
		}
	}
}

# administrative_palace_1: 4 frozen upgrade edge(s)
aub_upgrade_all_supported_buildings_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:aub_foreign_trade_post }
		clear_saved_scope = aub_foreign_trade_post
	}
	trade_post_district ?= {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					AND = {
						exists = district_owning_title
						district_owning_title = { holder = scope:aub_payer }
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = aub_foreign_trade_post
		}
	}
	every_built_buildings = {
		limit = {
			is_primary_building = yes
			scope:aub_payer = { var:aub_upgrades_this_scan < 15 }
		}
		building_district = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { exists = scope:aub_foreign_trade_post }
						NOT = { this = scope:aub_foreign_trade_post }
					}
				}
				aub_upgrade_supported_district_buildings_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
